name: toolseer-mobile
description: ToolSeer for Android — the same verified engines as the site, in a native shell that saves files natively instead of through a browser download.

scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease

comment: webDir points at the deployed site folder, so the app ships exactly the tree the gates verify — one source of truth, no copy to drift.
